script.title: How Zoomcar Finally Made a Profit #shorts

segments.text: Zoomcar just reported its first profit in company history.
After burning investor cash for over a decade, they pocketed nearly nine crore rupees.
So how did India’s favorite self-drive startup finally make money?
Instead of paying massive EMIs and garage bills on their own fleet, they shifted to host cars.
Now, ordinary car owners bear the depreciation risk, while Zoomcar simply collects a platform cut.
They cut discounts, passed maintenance onto hosts, and transformed into an asset-light middleman.
That quiet business pivot is the only reason...

script.description: After years of heavy losses, Zoomcar has recorded its first-ever quarterly net profit of $1.07 million. Here is the marketplace pivot that turned the rental company around. #zoomcar #businessdecoded #startupsindia

facts_to_verify.claim: Zoomcar posted its first net profit in company history of $1.07 million
Zoomcar transitioned from owning/leasing fleets to a peer-to-peer host marketplace model
